chapter: Failure in St. Louis and the Omaha bands
title: Leaving with the Warren Webb band for Omaha
summary: Despite his father's wish that he go to college, Thompson left with Warren Webb's tramp band to Omaha.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: And I had played a lot of parties around there and dances, as I said, solo piano playing at parties. So it was then that I knew that I wanted to be a musician. And a band came through there, a very, very raggedy type of band. You know, they weren't too good. You called them tramp

bands in those days. His name was Warren Webb. And he needed a piano player, so they waited for me until the next day, because I couldn't convince my father that I should go out again. But he let me be my own man, and he tried to discourage me. He wanted me to go to college, but he knew that I was going so he finally just -- I went off with this band.
And we went to Omaha, Nebraska, where I joined this band called Warren Webb, and these are some of the questions that I think that you're interested in.
